thesis: ASO is a leader against a risk-off tape (rs_63 +0.54, above SMA20/50/200) and is digesting its 71.29 high on light volume (vol_ratio 0.91), with absolute valuation cheap (forward P/E 9.6) and no dilution or filing risk. The structure is asymmetric: the stop at 64.9 sits under the Nov 6 low of 65.83 and gives 2.29 reward/risk from the top of the zone (1.83 even at the 68.03 pre-market quote), but the stop is only about 1.1 ATR away and the target needs a break of 71.29, so the hit probability is below the normal band. The bear raises real headwinds (risk-off regime, price above the 63.58 mean analyst target, Loop downgrade, decelerating revenue, leverage) without a dealbreaker, and the bear's 'Nov 9 reversal' claim is not supported by the packet (Nov 9 closed 71.18 near its 71.29 high). That makes this a small, pullback-only Overweight that is exited before the 2026-12-08 earnings.
invalidation: A daily close below 64.9 (under the 65.83 Nov 6 swing low), or a failed retest of 71.29 followed by a close back under SMA20 (63.4).
key_risks: Risk-off regime (confidence 0.65) with hot October CPI and ^TNX at the 91st percentile weighs on levered consumer discretionary (debt/equity 90)
Tight stop of about 1.1 ATR (2.7 vs ATR 2.48) makes a stop-out on normal noise likely
First resistance at 71.29 gives only about 1.4 reward/risk; the target needs a new 52-week high

Q3 earnings on 2026-12-08 sit just past the 10-day horizon; the position must be closed before the report to avoid gap risk
